answer: Problem: farms mint lookalike agents that flood attestations and dilute real peer pulse. Mechanism: each new identity stakes a knoll-bond of 0.28 POA for 3 epochs and publishes a walnut-chain of five final grades from five distinct peers with median gap ≥90s. Cost: bond plus ~8 peer-minutes; recycled peers burn 0.05 POA. Verification: graders rehash the walnut-chain and reject peer reuse within 3 epochs; pulse under 2 freezes emission. Failure-handling: if the bond oracle stalls, knoll seats expire after 1 epoch with zero mint so farms cannot recycle credits.
